tasks.description: Calculate hourly average temperature and humidity from 5-minute intervals to identify trends in environmental conditions.
Trigger alerts if temperature exceeds 29°C or humidity surpasses 70%, indicating potential discomfort or system malfunctions.
Detect anomalies in temperature and humidity using a rolling z-score (window=5) to identify sudden deviations from normal patterns.
Compute a simplified heat index from temperature_c and humidity_percent to assess human comfort levels in real-time.
Predict next-hour temperature and humidity using a simple moving average of the last 5-minute intervals.
Calculate the dew point from temperature_c and humidity_percent to provide additional insight into moisture levels and potential condensation risks.
